description_en: Queries the queues of a specified cluster
description_zh: 调用ListQueues查询指定集群的队列列表
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-queues --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --async false --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListQueues

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable asynchronous query
parameters.name: async

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type of the compute nodes

items.description_en: The instance type of compute node

DeploymentSetId.description_en: The ID of the deployment set to which to deploy the instance. You can call the [DescribeDeploymentSets]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91313.html） operation to query the deployment set ID. Only the deployment sets that use low latency policies are supported
DeploymentSetId.description_zh:
部署集ID。
您可以通过[DescribeDeploymentSets]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91313.html）获取部署集ID，当前仅支持网络低时延策略的部署集

EnableAutoGrow.description_en:
Indicates whether auto scale-out is enabled for the queue. Valid values:

true
false
EnableAutoGrow.description_zh:
队列是否启动自动扩容。可能值：

true：已启动
false：未启动

HostNamePrefix.description_zh: 队列中计算节点的主机名前缀名称

HostNameSuffix.description_zh: 队列中计算节点的主机名后缀名称

NetworkInterfaceTrafficMode.description_en:
The communication mode of the elastic network interface (ENI). Valid values:

Standard: The TCP communication mode is used.
HighPerformance: The Elastic RDMA Interface (ERI) is enabled and the remote direct memory access (RDMA) communication mode is used
NetworkInterfaceTrafficMode.description_zh:
弹性网卡的通讯模式。取值范围：

Standard：使用TCP通讯模式。
HighPerformance：开启ERI（Elastic RDMA Interface）接口，使用RDMA通讯模式

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the queue belongs

Instance.description_en: The information about the preemptible instance

items.description_en: The information about the preemptible instance

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type of the preemptible instance

SpotPriceLimit.description_en: The maximum hourly price of the instance. The price can be accurate to three decimal places. This parameter is valid only when the SpotStrategy parameter is set to SpotWithPriceLimit
SpotPriceLimit.description_zh: 实例的每小时最高价格，支持最多3位小数。参数SpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时生效

SpotStrategy.description_en:
The preemption policy of the compute nodes. Valid values:

NoSpot: The instance is a regular pay-as-you-go instance.
SpotWithPriceLimit: The instance is a preemptible instance for which you specify the maximum hourly price.
SpotAsPriceGo: The instance is a preemptible instance for which the market price at the time of purchase is automatically used as the bid price
SpotStrategy.description_zh:
计算节点抢占策略。可能值：

NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格

Type.description_en:
The type of queue. Valid values:

Execution: Queues in which jobs can be executed.
Router: Queues in which jobs cannot be executed. The received jobs in the queues must be forwarded to the bound Execution queues for execution
Type.description_zh:
队列类型。可能值：

Execution：可以执行作业的队列。
Router：不能执行作业，只会将接受的作业转发至绑定的Execution队列执行

UseESS.description_en: Specifies whether to use scaling groups of Auto Scaling
